say: A driller sits out of the rain under the wash-house awning, turning an unlit hand-lamp over and over.
You're not off the pods. If it's the tram you want, it's the other side of town.
Then you've picked the wrong stairs. Nothing down here but a locked gate.

choices.text: Who gave the order to pull the crew?

say: Number Two? Roof came in on the lower level. That's what the notice says.
I was on the lower level that shift. They pulled us at the half. Whole crew, up and out, no reason given.
The collapse got reported after. We were already in the wash-house.
I've listened to that rock most of my life. It talks before it goes. That night it said nothing.
Came down the line from the site office. No name on it.
Ask the gate, if you like. Same guard was on that night. You'll get the notice read back to you.
The mine door is welded shut. From the outside. The stretchers were never unwrapped.
The driller stops turning the lamp.
You didn't tell me that. And I'd go on not telling people, if I were you.
